entries.10f5fac4dd27a126: To achieve its long-term management vision “LIVZON DREAM 2030,” it has formulated the medium-term management plan “LIVZON DREAM 2030 2nd half!” covering fiscal 2026 to 2030. Its three growth strategies are “expanding high-level engineering fields,” which applies technical capabilities developed in industrial and medical facility projects; “maximizing stock revenue,” which maximizes recurring revenue in the maintenance and renovation field; and “improving productivity” through DX, standardization and use of external resources. It has set the brand statement “Tatemono o, ikimono ni” (“Turning buildings into living things”) and aims to leap forward as a “comprehensive building services company.”
